preconditions.description: Board dimensions and chip count are within stated bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= sx_i <= n and 1 <= sy_i <= m for sx_i, sy_i in start_positions) and all(1 <= fx_i <= n and 1 <= fy_i <= m for fx_i, fy_i in target_positions)
preconditions.description: All starting and target positions are within the board boundaries.
Number of start and target positions match the chip count.

postconditions.description: The number of operations does not exceed the limit, or -1 is returned if impossible.

postconditions.expression: all(any((sx_i + dx == fx_i and sy_i + dy == fy_i) for dx, dy in get_chip_path(start_positions[i], operations)) for i in range(k)) if operations != [-1] else True
postconditions.description: Each chip's path (derived from operations) includes its target position, or -1 is returned if impossible.

postconditions.expression: operations == [-1] or (len(operations) > 0 and all(op in ['L', 'R', 'U', 'D'] for op in operations))
postconditions.description: If operations are provided, they are a non-empty sequence of valid move characters.
